howToPlay: Throw the Knuckle Busters to damage enemies and retrieve them to deal more damage. Use Magnetic Field or Pulse Repellent to control enemy positioning. Strategically pick up the Knuckle Busters to trigger Hearty Recovery for sustained combat.
gears: Equip SPEED to capitalize on the assassin role and SHIELD to increase survivability while engaging in close-range combat.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy aggressive playstyles that rely on managing cooldowns and positioning abilities.
